script.title: ଜଗନ୍ନାଥ ମୂର୍ତ୍ତି ବିନା ହାତରେ ଅଧୁରା କାହିଁକି ରହିଗଲା?
sentences: ପୁରୀ ଜଗନ୍ନାଥ ମନ୍ଦିରର ମୂର୍ତ୍ତିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବିନା ହାତରେ ଅଧୁରା କାହିଁକି ରହିଛି?
ମାଦଳା ପାଞ୍ଜି ଅନୁସାରେ, ସତ୍ୟ ଯୁଗରେ ମାଳବର ରାଜା ଇନ୍ଦ୍ରଦ୍ୟୁମ୍ନ ପ୍ରଭୁଙ୍କ ମୂର୍ତ୍ତି ଗଢ଼ିବାକୁ ଚାହିଁଥିଲେ।
ସ୍ୱୟଂ ବିଶ୍ୱକର୍ମା ଜଣେ କାଠକାରିଗର ରୂପ ନେଇ ମୂର୍ତ୍ତି ତିଆରି କରିବା ଆରମ୍ଭ କଲେ।
କାମ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ନ ହେବା ଯାଏ କେହି ଦୁଆର ଖୋଲିବେ ନାହିଁ ବୋଲି ସେ ସର୍ତ୍ତ ରଖିଥିଲେ।
ଦୁଇ ସପ୍ତାହ ବିତିଗଲା, କିନ୍ତୁ ମନ୍ଦିର ଭିତରୁ କୌଣସି ଶବ୍ଦ ଶୁଣାଗଲା ନାହିଁ।
କାରିଗର ମରିଯାଇଛନ୍ତି ଭାବି ରାଣୀ ବ୍ୟାକୁଳ ହୋଇ ରାଜାଙ୍କୁ ଦ୍ୱାର ଖୋଲିବାକୁ କହିଲେ।
ରାଜା ଦ୍ୱାର ଖୋଲିବା ମାତ୍ରେ କାରିଗର ଗାୟବ ହୋଇଗଲେ ଏବଂ ମୂର୍ତ୍ତିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବିନା ହାତରେ ରହିଗଲା।
ଆଜି ବି ବିଶ୍ୱାସ କରାଯାଏ ଯେ ବିନା ହାତରେ ବି ସେ ସାରା ଜଗତକୁ ରକ୍ଷା କରନ୍ତି।
scenes: Extreme close-up of Lord Jagannath's wooden face, black face, huge round white eyes and wide red smile, garlands of flowers, glowing in oil-lamp light inside the Puri temple.
King Indradyumna of Malava in royal attire and crown standing on a seashore at dawn, hands folded, determined to create the Lord's image, waves and golden light, wide shot.
Vishwakarma disguised as an old carpenter with a white beard and chisel, beginning to carve a great log of sacred wood inside a closed temple room, divine glow, medium shot.
The old carpenter raising one finger, solemnly warning King Indradyumna not to open the door until the work is done, the king nodding, temple doorway, lamplight, medium shot.
The closed wooden temple door in silence, the queen and courtiers listening anxiously with ears close to it, days passing in shadows, dim evening light, medium shot.
The worried queen in a silk sari and gold jewellery pleading with King Indradyumna, her face full of anxiety, the closed temple door behind them, flickering lamplight, close medium shot.
King Indradyumna throwing open the temple door to find the carpenter vanished and the wooden deities of Jagannath standing unfinished without hands, the king's face stunned, divine light pouring in.
Lord Jagannath with huge round eyes and wide smile on a grand chariot during Rath Yatra in Puri, vast crowds of devotees pulling ropes, golden sunset light, wide shot.
script.description:
ପୁରୀ ଜଗନ୍ନାଥ ମନ୍ଦିର ମୂର୍ତ୍ତି ନିର୍ମାଣର ପୌରାଣିକ କଥା।
ଜାଣନ୍ତୁ ମୂର୍ତ୍ତିଗୁଡ଼ିକ କାହିଁକି ବିନା ହାତରେ ଅଧୁରା ରହିଲା।
visuals: Jagannath Temple Puri sanctum wooden deities
King Indradyumna Jagannath Puri legend painting
Vishwakarma carpenter wooden idols Jagannath Puri
Jagannath Balabhadra Subhadra idols without hands Puri
claims_en: According to Madala Panji legends, King Indradyumna of Malava in Satya Yuga commissioned the original Jagannath temple and deities.
Vishwakarma appeared in the disguise of a carpenter to carve the wooden deities.
The carpenter set a condition that he must be left undisturbed until he finished the work.
After two weeks without any sound from inside, the queen panicked thinking the carpenter was dead and asked the king to open the door.
When King Indradyumna opened the door, the carpenter vanished, leaving the deities incomplete without hands.
It is believed that despite being without hands, the deity watches over and protects the world.
